story.iWant: each free-agent session to run under its own short-lived AWS IAM credentials inside a path-confined git worktree
story.soThat: a runaway or compromised session cannot damage shared infrastructure or escape its project's scope, even though the agent has full Claude Code tool access
story.tasks:
Infrastructure (SST): - Modify sst.config.ts — add FreeAgentSessionRole as a standalone aws.iam.Role (trust policy: AssumeRole from API Lambda exec role only; inline permissions policy implementing AC #1's read-scope + explicit-deny). Export role ARN; grant the API Lambda execution role sts:AssumeRole + sts:TagSession on the new role's ARN (with a Condition requiring the project/sessionId session tags to be present). Add FREE_AGENT_SESSION_ROLE_ARN env var on the API Lambda. (AC #1, AC #2) - Add @aws-sdk/client-sts to root package.json (not currently a dependency).
Shared library (functions/shared/lib/free-agent-iam.ts — NEW directory): - Create functions/shared/lib/free-agent-iam.ts exporting assumeFreeAgentSessionRole({projectId, sessionId, operatorId}): Promise<SessionCredentials>, refreshSessionCredentials(session): Promise<SessionCredentials | null>, and a redactCredentials(err) internal helper. Use @aws-sdk/client-sts AssumeRoleCommand with Tags + RoleSessionName (truncated to 64 chars) + DurationSeconds=3600. Type SessionCredentials = { accessKeyId, secretAccessKey, sessionToken, expiration }. (AC #2, AC #3) - Create functions/shared/lib/__tests__/free-agent-iam.test.ts — covers AssumeRole call shape, role-session-name truncation, refresh trigger at <5 min expiry, refresh no-op on fresh creds, credential redaction in thrown errors. (AC #8 a-d)
Daemon — worktree manager: - Create daemon/pipelines/lib/free-agent-worktree.mjs exporting ensureWorktree({projectId, sessionId, defaultBranch}) (idempotent), writeFreeAgentSettings({worktreePath, projectId, sessionId}) (atomic .claude/settings.json write with PreToolUse hook reference), reapWorktree({projectId, sessionId}). Uses `git worktree add -b assist/<projectId>/<sessionId> <path> origin/<defaultBranch>` against the per-project bare repo. Detect existing worktree via <path>/.git presence + branch match. (AC #4, AC #5, AC #7) - Create daemon/pipelines/__tests__/free-agent-worktree.test.mjs — covers fresh create spawn args, idempotent return on existing worktree, settings.json atomic write with hook reference, GC reap of 7+ day idle session, GC NOT reaping ACTIVE/PROCESSING session, orphan worktree removal. Mock child_process.spawn + fs/promises. (AC #8 e-j)
Daemon — path-confinement hook (bash): - Create daemon/pipelines/lib/free-agent-path-hook.sh — reads $CLAUDE_TOOL_NAME + $CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT env. For Bash tool only: parses command, extracts cd <path> and absolute-path args, resolves relative to $PWD, asserts within $FREE_AGENT_CONFINEMENT_ROOT. Exits 1 (deny) with informative stderr on escape; 0 (allow) otherwise. $FREE_AGENT_CONFINEMENT_ROOT set per-session by daemon via spawn env. (AC #5) - Create daemon/pipelines/__tests__/free-agent-path-hook.test.mjs — invokes the bash script via child_process.execFile with controlled env; covers cd /etc rejection, cd src allow, relative + absolute + chained cd handling, informative stderr on rejection. (AC #8 k-n)
Daemon — GC routine: - Implement GC logic per AC #6 — list /home/ubuntu/free-agent-worktrees/*/*/ via fs.readdir, look up sessions in futurator-free-agent-sessions (table introduced by Story 18.2; for 18.1 scaffold the GC reading session rows directly via @aws-sdk/lib-dynamodb ScanCommand with lastActivityAt < :sevenDaysAgo filter). Reap if status IN (IDLE,EXPIRED,BUDGET_EXHAUSTED) AND lastActivityAt > 7 days. Remove orphans with no DDB row. NEVER reap ACTIVE/PROCESSING regardless of age. Emit a single free-agent.gc.run summary event. - Decision point during implementation: fold GC into an existing cron Lambda (tag-auditor.ts or pat-age-check.ts under functions/cron/) OR create a new functions/cron/free-agent-gc.ts. Per [[ship-mvp-add-complexity-later]], prefer folding if cheap; create new if folding muddies an existing handler. - Wire cron schedule in sst.config.ts at `cron(0 3 * * ? *)` (daily 03:00 UTC). (AC #6)
Documentation: - Modify CLAUDE.md — add a brief "Free Agent (Epic 18)" section noting the worktree path convention /home/ubuntu/free-agent-worktrees/<projectId>/<sessionId>/ and the assist/<projectId>/<sessionId> branch namespace; point to docs/epics-free-agent.md as the canonical scope. - Modify daemon/README.md — document GC cadence (daily 03:00 UTC) and a manual reap recipe (`node -e "import('./pipelines/lib/free-agent-worktree.mjs').then(m => m.reapWorktree({projectId, sessionId}))"`).
Validation: - Run npm run ci end-to-end; zero warnings, all tests pass, build succeeds. (AC #10) - EC2 dev manual verification per AC #9 steps 1-7: deploy role, verify scoped credentials via aws CLI (iam:list-users denied, dynamodb:get-item allowed, lambda:update-function-code denied, secretsmanager:get-secret-value denied), create worktree manually, verify hook rejects /tmp escape and allows in-scope ls.

story-context.acceptanceCriteria:
AC #1 — New SST-managed IAM role FreeAgentSessionRole (in sst.config.ts) with trust policy allowing STS AssumeRole ONLY from the futurator-admin API Lambda's execution role ARN; permissions policy implements the read-scoped + explicit-deny pattern: Allow: s3:GetObject/ListBucket on s3://futurator-ai-website/knowledge-live/${aws:PrincipalTag/project}/* (with s3:prefix resource condition). Allow: dynamodb:GetItem/Query/Scan on futurator-agent-jobs (+ GSIs), futurator-attention-items, futurator-plans, futurator-free-agent-conversations, futurator-free-agent-sessions. Allow: dynamodb:PutItem/UpdateItem on futurator-free-agent-conversations with dynamodb:LeadingKeys condition restricted to ${aws:PrincipalTag/sessionId}. Explicit Deny on iam:*, lambda:UpdateFunctionCode, lambda:DeleteFunction, secretsmanager:GetSecretValue, secretsmanager:PutSecretValue, s3:DeleteObject, s3:PutBucketPolicy, dynamodb:DeleteTable, dynamodb:UpdateTable.
AC #2 — ${project} and ${sessionId} in the policy resolve via STS session tags. Given functions/shared/lib/free-agent-iam.ts:assumeFreeAgentSessionRole(projectId, sessionId, operatorId), the AssumeRole call includes Tags: [{Key:'project',Value:projectId},{Key:'sessionId',Value:sessionId},{Key:'operator',Value:operatorId}], RoleSessionName: <projectId>--<sessionId>--<operatorId> truncated to 64 chars per STS limits, DurationSeconds: 3600. Returned credentials (AccessKeyId, SecretAccessKey, SessionToken, Expiration) are NEVER logged, NEVER written to event payloads, NEVER persisted in DDB — passed in-memory to the daemon via the existing encrypted job-dispatch payload.
AC #3 — Given an active session whose credentials are within 5 min of Expiration (or already expired), when the operator sends a new message, then refreshSessionCredentials(session) is invoked first; re-runs AssumeRole with the same session tags; replaces credentials in the daemon's in-memory session state; the Claude CLI subprocess receives refreshed credentials via process.env on the next spawn (NOTE: process.env cannot be patched on a running subprocess — refresh applies to the NEXT turn). Session's lastRefreshedAt is updated in DDB.
AC #4 — Given a free-agent session being created for the first time on a project, when daemon/pipelines/lib/free-agent-worktree.mjs:ensureWorktree({projectId, sessionId, defaultBranch}) is invoked, it creates a fresh worktree at /home/ubuntu/free-agent-worktrees/<projectId>/<sessionId>/ via `git worktree add -b assist/<projectId>/<sessionId> <path> origin/<defaultBranch>`. Returns {worktreePath, branchName}. defaultBranch defaults to 'main' when not provided.
AC #5 — Worktree path-confinement enforced by .claude/settings.json written into the worktree on create, containing a PreToolUse hook that rejects any Bash tool invocation whose effective working directory escapes /home/ubuntu/free-agent-worktrees/<projectId>/<sessionId>/. Hook script at daemon/pipelines/lib/free-agent-path-hook.sh, templated per session, referenced by absolute path. Returns non-zero (deny) with clear stderr on escape, zero (allow) otherwise. Settings file is written ATOMICALLY (temp + rename) so a partial-write race cannot leave the hook half-configured.
AC #6 — New cron schedule daemon-free-agent-gc runs daily at 03:00 UTC. GC routine: list worktrees under /home/ubuntu/free-agent-worktrees/*/*/; look up sessions in futurator-free-agent-sessions; REAP if status IN (IDLE,EXPIRED,BUDGET_EXHAUSTED) AND lastActivityAt >7 days ago via `git worktree remove --force <path>` + `git branch -D assist/<projectId>/<sessionId>`; REMOVE orphans with no DDB row; DO NOT reap ACTIVE/PROCESSING regardless of age. Emit single free-agent.gc.run event summarizing {reapedCount, orphansRemoved, kept}.
AC #7 — ensureWorktree is idempotent. Given a session whose worktree already exists at the expected path, when ensureWorktree is called again, it returns the existing {worktreePath, branchName} WITHOUT re-cloning, WITHOUT erroring, WITHOUT modifying contents. Detection via existence check on <path>/.git + verify branch matches assist/<projectId>/<sessionId>.
AC #8 — Unit tests pass: functions/shared/lib/__tests__/free-agent-iam.test.ts (NEW): (a) AssumeRole call shape + session tags + role-session-name format and truncation + 3600s duration; (b) refreshSessionCredentials fires when expiry <5 min; (c) refreshSessionCredentials no-op when credentials fresh; (d) credentials never leak into thrown error messages. daemon/pipelines/__tests__/free-agent-worktree.test.mjs (NEW): (e) fresh worktree create spawn args; (f) idempotent return on existing worktree; (g) settings.json written atomically with hook reference; (h) GC reaps 7+ day idle worktree; (i) GC does NOT reap ACTIVE session even if lastActivityAt >7 days; (j) GC removes orphan worktrees with no DDB row. daemon/pipelines/__tests__/free-agent-path-hook.test.mjs (NEW): (k) hook rejects cd /etc && ls; (l) hook allows ls -la src/; (m) hook handles relative/absolute/chained cd; (n) informative stderr on rejection.
AC #9 — Manual verification on EC2 dev: deploy role; from API Lambda call AssumeRole with test tags; using returned credentials in aws CLI: list-users → AccessDenied, get-item futurator-attention-items → success/NotFound (NOT AccessDenied), update-function-code → AccessDenied (explicit Deny), get-secret-value any-secret → AccessDenied. SSH to EC2; invoke ensureWorktree manually; verify worktree exists. cd into worktree; `claude -p "ls -la /tmp"` → hook rejects with informative stderr. `claude -p "ls -la ."` → hook allows; agent lists worktree contents. Document deviations in Dev Notes.
AC #10 — `npm run ci` passes end-to-end (eslint --max-warnings 0, format:check, knip, typecheck, vitest, build).

doc.title: Epic 18 — Free Claude Code Agent (Pipeline v2 enhancement)
doc.section: Story 18.1 — Per-session IAM role + path-confined worktree
doc.snippet: Canonical scope, ACs, prerequisites, and tech notes for the foundational architecture story. v1 carries the v2-shaped security/audit posture; layer-C write credentials deferred. Followed by Stories 18.2-18.6 in dependency order.

doc.title: Pipeline v2 Assessment — plan_dino-7_mp8t4wak forensic
doc.section: TL;DR + §2 Findings (P0-1 cron-dispatch divergence, P0-3 silent plan-build failure)
doc.snippet: ~3-hour manual forensic that motivates the Free Agent feature. A plan-scoped agent with read access to DDB + S3 + the project worktree would have surfaced "cron Lambda emitting legacy pipeline shape" in minutes. The "Maybe stuck. The signal is rate, not state." class is the operator-facing pain.

doc.title: Project guidance for Claude Code (Futurator-Admin)
doc.snippet: Hono.js single-Lambda API; DynamoDB one-table-per-concern; auth via Identity Broker JWT in Authorization: Bearer header; zod schemas use .safeParse() only; API_BASE_URL stays relative in production; npm run ci is the gate (lint + format + knip + typecheck + test + build).

doc.title: Project guidance for Claude Code (Futurator-Admin)
doc.section: DEPLOY SAFETY — DO NOT SYNC out/ TO futurator-ai-website
doc.snippet: admin.futurator.ai and futurator.ai are SEPARATE buckets. Admin writes only scoped paths in the public bucket (knowledge-live/, data/projects.json, media/, apps/). FreeAgentSessionRole's s3 scope MUST stay confined to s3://futurator-ai-website/knowledge-live/${project}/* — never grant broader s3 access on the public bucket.

doc.title: Futurator Agent Daemon README
doc.section: (existing) — extended in this story with GC cadence + manual reap recipe
doc.snippet: Existing daemon docs cover Claude CLI subprocess spawn, OAuth refresh, job polling, and SST-Secret PAT loads (BrownfieldGithubPat precedent). This story adds a new section documenting daily 03:00 UTC GC and the operator-facing manual reap command.

doc.title: User memory — ship MVP, add complexity later
doc.section: Design preference observed across the party-mode debate 2026-05-17
doc.snippet: Operator prefers the simpler shippable shape. Informs the GC scope (no "extend session" UI), the cron consolidation decision (fold into existing if cheap), and the credential-refresh approach (don't kill running subprocesses — refresh applies to next turn). Surface richer alternatives as "if and when" not "we should design for this now."

doc.title: User memory — brownfield party permission mode (path-scoped deferral)
doc.snippet: Path-scoped Edit/Write restrictions for brownfield Party were deferred because they require settings.json + PreToolUse hooks (not a single CLI flag). Story 18.1 crosses the threshold for the Free Agent — settings.json + PreToolUse hook IS the path-confinement enforcement mechanism here. The trade-off has been re-evaluated for this higher-blast-radius surface.

doc.title: User memory — DynamoDB multi-table preference
doc.snippet: Never use single-table design. This story's IAM policy grants on futurator-free-agent-sessions / futurator-free-agent-conversations are designed to align with new dedicated tables (introduced in Stories 18.2 and 18.6). The 18.1 policy includes them by name so the role is correctly scoped on the first deploy of those tables.

doc.title: Exploration Rigor Addendum (source spec for Epic 19)
doc.section: §5 The carry-forward mechanism (informs Epic 18 runtime reusability)
doc.snippet: External reference. Epic 19 (deferred) will reuse Epic 18's runtime for REFLECTOR-FINDINGS mode. Story 18.1's IAM role is intentionally scoped so Epic 19's exploration-rigor agent can extend (not replace) the same role with project-repo write capability on experiment/ branches.

story-context.constraints: - The per-session IAM role is the load-bearing security primitive for the entire Free Agent feature. All subsequent stories (18.2-18.6) inherit its scope. Get this story right or every later story becomes harder to reason about. [Source: party-mode debate 2026-05-17 Sean Tinel; docs/epics-free-agent.md Epic Goal] - Build the v2-shaped security posture from day one even though v1 features don't exercise it. Per-session role assumption is a 4-hour task today and a 4-week migration later. Do NOT ship a shared role. [Source: party-mode debate 2026-05-17 Rick round 5; docs/epics-free-agent.md Sequencing rationale] - Credentials NEVER persist. STS session token format (in-memory) → encrypted job-dispatch envelope → daemon spawn env. Replaced on refresh, not stored. Any DDB write or event payload containing accessKeyId is a defect. [Source: AC #2 + party-mode Sean] - Path-confinement enforced by Claude Code PreToolUse hook on Bash, NOT by IAM. IAM has DDB/S3 scopes; filesystem scope is hook-enforced. This is the "trivially achievable" threshold from [[brownfield-party-permission-mode]] memory — the Free Agent's blast radius crosses it. [Source: party-mode debate 2026-05-17 Sean round 1; memory feedback_brownfield_party_permission_mode] - Worktree paths NEVER shared with pipeline worktrees. Pipeline worktrees live elsewhere (verify during implementation — likely /home/ubuntu/worktrees/<project>/<plan>/). Free-agent worktrees ALWAYS at /home/ubuntu/free-agent-worktrees/<projectId>/<sessionId>/. Different branch namespaces (assist/ vs wip/ vs experiment/), zero overlap. [Source: party-mode debate 2026-05-17 Ludwig round 1] - The assist/<projectId>/<sessionId> branch namespace is sacred. No pipeline tooling touches these branches. No auto-PR. No auto-merge. Operator manually cherry-picks anything they want to keep. [Source: party-mode debate 2026-05-17 Ludwig + Sean round 1] - GC is a safety net, not a feature. 7-day retention is intentionally conservative. If operators need longer-running investigations, raise the threshold — do NOT build an "extend session" UI. [Source: party-mode debate 2026-05-17 Pedrock; memory feedback_ship_mvp_add_later] - process.env CANNOT be patched on a running subprocess. Credential refresh applies to the NEXT spawn. Mid-flight AWS calls in a turn whose credentials expire WILL fail; daemon must NOT interrupt the turn but MUST refresh before the next spawn. Document this in daemon logs. [Source: AC #3 + implementation reality] - One table per concern. Free-agent IS a new concern; create new dedicated tables (futurator-free-agent-sessions in Story 18.2, futurator-free-agent-conversations in Story 18.6) rather than reuse dormant Pipeline-v1 tables. [Source: memory feedback_dynamodb_multi_table; CLAUDE.md Key Conventions] - S3 IAM scope MUST stay confined to knowledge-live/${project}/*. NEVER grant broader access on s3://futurator-ai-website. Public homepage at futurator.ai is in the same bucket; broader access creates risk per [[futurator-dual-bucket-setup]]. [Source: CLAUDE.md DEPLOY SAFETY block; memory project_dual_bucket_setup] - Explicit-deny block on iam:*, lambda:UpdateFunctionCode, lambda:DeleteFunction, secretsmanager:*, s3:DeleteObject, s3:PutBucketPolicy, dynamodb:DeleteTable, dynamodb:UpdateTable is the seatbelt — even if a permission is added upstream by accident, these stay denied. [Source: AC #1 + party-mode Sean round 1] - Layer C (per-session AWS WRITE credentials beyond own-conversation DDB writes) is NOT in v1. If operator needs the agent to do AWS writes, they run those in their own terminal. v2 may revisit. [Source: docs/epics-free-agent.md scope; party-mode round 5] - Reactive auto-spawn on pipeline failures was killed in party-mode round 2. Widget is operator-initiated only. Story 18.1 does NOT implement any spawn-trigger logic. [Source: party-mode debate 2026-05-17 round 2; docs/epics-free-agent.md Out of Scope] - All zod validation via .safeParse() only (where added downstream). Errors via AppError/ValidationError from functions/shared/errors.ts. [Source: CLAUDE.md Validation] - npm run ci must pass with zero warnings: eslint --max-warnings 0, format:check, knip, typecheck, vitest, build. [Source: CLAUDE.md Commands; package.json ci script] - API_BASE_URL stays relative in production. Not directly applicable to Story 18.1 (no UI code) but constrains downstream story 18.5. [Source: CLAUDE.md Key Conventions] - Atomic file writes for security-relevant files (settings.json): write to temp file in same directory, then rename. Avoids partial-write races where the hook could be half-configured. [Source: AC #5]

interface.name: assumeFreeAgentSessionRole
interface.signature:
assumeFreeAgentSessionRole({ projectId: string, // e.g. 'dino-7' sessionId: string, // uuid operatorId: string, // from JWT sub claim }): Promise<SessionCredentials>
Calls @aws-sdk/client-sts AssumeRoleCommand: RoleArn: process.env.FREE_AGENT_SESSION_ROLE_ARN RoleSessionName: `${projectId}--${sessionId}--${operatorId}`.slice(0, 64) DurationSeconds: 3600 Tags: [ { Key: 'project', Value: projectId }, { Key: 'sessionId', Value: sessionId }, { Key: 'operator', Value: operatorId }, ]
Returns: { accessKeyId, secretAccessKey, sessionToken, expiration } (ISO-8601 expiration). Throws (with credential redaction) on any STS error.

interface.name: refreshSessionCredentials
interface.signature:
refreshSessionCredentials(session: { projectId, sessionId, operatorId, expiration }): Promise<SessionCredentials | null>
Returns null if Date.now() < expiration - 5min (still fresh — no-op). Otherwise calls assumeFreeAgentSessionRole with same tags and returns fresh credentials. Caller is responsible for updating the daemon's in-memory session state and the session's lastRefreshedAt in DDB.

interface.name: SessionCredentials (type)
ensureWorktree
interface.signature:
ensureWorktree({ projectId: string, sessionId: string, defaultBranch?: string, // default 'main' }): Promise<{ worktreePath: string, branchName: string }>
Idempotent. If a worktree already exists at /home/ubuntu/free-agent-worktrees/<projectId>/<sessionId>/ AND its branch matches assist/<projectId>/<sessionId>, returns the existing { worktreePath, branchName } without re-cloning or modifying contents.
Otherwise spawns: git worktree add -b assist/<projectId>/<sessionId> <path> origin/<defaultBranch> against the per-project bare repo at /home/ubuntu/repos/<projectId>.git (verify path during implementation).

interface.name: writeFreeAgentSettings
reapWorktree
interface.signature:
reapWorktree({ projectId: string, sessionId: string, }): Promise<void>
Spawns: git worktree remove --force /home/ubuntu/free-agent-worktrees/<projectId>/<sessionId>/ Then: git branch -D assist/<projectId>/<sessionId> Used by GC routine. Idempotent — succeeds even if path or branch already gone (treat 'not found' as success).

interface.name: free-agent-path-hook.sh (PreToolUse hook contract)
interface.signature:
Invoked by Claude Code PreToolUse mechanism. Stdin: none. Env vars: CLAUDE_TOOL_NAME — 'Bash' for our matcher; pass-through allow on others CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT — JSON: { command: string, ... } (Bash tool input) FREE_AGENT_CONFINEMENT_ROOT — absolute path the agent must stay within PWD — current working directory (provided by Claude Code)
Behavior (Bash only): - Parse CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT.command - Extract any `cd <path>` and absolute-path args - Resolve each relative to $PWD - If any resolved path is OUTSIDE $FREE_AGENT_CONFINEMENT_ROOT → exit 1 with stderr - Otherwise → exit 0
Exit code 0 = allow; non-zero = deny.

interface.name: GC routine entry point
interface.signature:
handler(event: ScheduledEvent): Promise<{ reapedCount, orphansRemoved, kept }>
Steps: 1. fs.readdir /home/ubuntu/free-agent-worktrees/ → projectIds 2. for each projectId: fs.readdir → sessionIds 3. for each (projectId, sessionId): query futurator-free-agent-sessions for the row (during 18.1 stub: ScanCommand with lastActivityAt < :sevenDaysAgo filter — Story 18.2 will provide a typed repository method) 4. Decide reap/keep/orphan per AC #6 rules 5. For reap candidates: invoke reapWorktree 6. For orphans: remove worktree path + branch 7. Emit single free-agent.gc.run event to futurator-agent-events 8. Return summary
Scheduled via SST cron(0 3 * * ? *).
